excerpt: MESA turns plain-English requests into Shopify automations across 100+ apps: describe the workflow to its AI assistant Yedric and it builds the triggers, conditions and actions. Free plan with 50 tasks; paid from $12 a month. Pricing, debugging and alternatives.
content:
MESA is a workflow automation platform for ecommerce teams, made by ShopPad, which has built Shopify apps since 2012. You describe a task in plain language, such as giving each new customer a unique discount code or pushing orders to Google Sheets, and MESA's AI assistant, Yedric, asks a few clarifying questions and builds the workflow. You can then change it by chatting with Yedric or by editing steps, conditions and filters in a visual builder. MESA connects to more than 100 apps, including Shopify, Etsy, Google Sheets, Klaviyo, QuickBooks, Slack, Claude and ChatGPT, has more than 400 templates, and also handles generic webhooks, APIs and FTP for systems outside commerce.

Workflows can pause for human approval before acting, for example before publishing an AI-written product description. When something breaks, MESA offers step-by-step logs, failure notifications, a Time Travel feature for replaying runs and workflow tests to check a fix before it goes live. An MCP server lets Claude and ChatGPT reach your store data through MESA. According to MESA, more than 3,000 ecommerce teams use it.

MESA was co-founded by Aaron Wadler and Ryan O'Donnell. It launched on Product Hunt on 7 May 2026 and finished #2 for the day with 208 upvotes and 41 comments.

We have not tested MESA ourselves. This page brings together MESA's website, pricing, about and contact pages, its Product Hunt page and launch discussion, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.summary_short: Builds Shopify automations across 100+ apps from a plain-English description

gallery.alt: MESA's assistant Yedric setting up a workflow to create unique discount codes for new Shopify customers
MESA workflow builder: customer created, create price rule, send message
MESA approvals queue holding AI-written product descriptions for a person to approve or deny

paragraphs: Aaron Wadler opened by asking merchants what their Shopify store should be doing automatically but isn't, and said the list he hears is long: routing priority or wholesale orders differently, syncing orders and products to Google Sheets without breaking, follow-ups after specific purchases and cleaning messy tags and data.
MESA's answer is to let merchants describe those jobs in plain English and have the automation built for them, with the option to adjust it later by chat or in the builder.
launch_story.attribution: Aaron Wadler, co-founder, on Product Hunt

use_cases: Routing priority, VIP or wholesale orders to the warehouse differently
Syncing orders, customers and products to Google Sheets or QuickBooks
Tagging orders and customers automatically based on rules
Generating product descriptions with AI and approving them before they go live
Connecting Shopify to non-commerce systems through webhooks and APIs

fit: run a Shopify store and repeat the same order, inventory or fulfilment tasks
have outgrown Shopify Flow for complex workflows
want automation without writing code, with free setup help
not_fit: need very high-volume, low-latency syncs on the cheapest plans (4 requests a second, one worker)
do not use Shopify and want a general-purpose automation tool with more connectors
want unlimited runs on a small budget: tasks are capped per plan

pricing.intro: MESA prices by tasks per month, with unlimited workflows on every plan. Prices are in US dollars from MESA's pricing page; paid plans start with a 7-day trial.

plans.name: Starter
plans.detail: 50 tasks a month, templates, free setup session, email and chat support

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.detail: Unlimited tasks, 4 parallel workers, longer logs

notes: Extra tasks cost $0.01 each; premium tasks over the allowance cost $0.02.
After the 7-day trial the saved card is charged on day 8 unless you cancel.
Custom plans for high-volume stores and agencies.

alternatives.intro: Product Hunt lists Zapier, Make and Relay.app among MESA's alternatives. Review scores are Product Hunt users' own; check each tool's pricing page for current prices.

items.name: Zapier
items.difference: Far more connectors across all software; MESA is built around Shopify data and store operations.

items.name: Make
items.difference: A visual builder for any workflow; MESA leads with plain-English building and free setup help for merchants.

items.name: Relay.app
items.what: AI agents and workflow automation with human-in-the-loop steps
items.difference: General business automation; MESA specialises in ecommerce.

alternatives.more: Product Hunt also lists Albato and Trace.

liked: Replaying a run after a fix (Time Travel) and testing before going live
Clarifying questions before building a workflow

faq.a: A workflow automation platform for Shopify and ecommerce teams that builds automations from plain-English descriptions, made by ShopPad.
Free for 50 tasks a month; Basic $12, Flex $29, Pro $99 and Unlimited $299 a month.

faq.q: Can I edit a workflow MESA's AI built?
faq.a: Yes, by asking the assistant Yedric or by editing it in the visual workflow builder.

faq.q: Does it work with tools outside Shopify?
faq.a: Yes. It connects to 100+ apps and supports generic webhooks, APIs and FTP.

faq.q: What happens when a workflow fails?
faq.a: MESA can alert your team, shows step-by-step logs, and lets you test a fix and replay runs.
Product Hunt lists Zapier, Albato, Make, Trace and Relay.app.
